summary: In the alley in daylight, Neo scrambles up the fire escape while bullets spark and ricochet around him. Agents Brown and Jones are closing the gap on him.

what_changes.before: In pursuit of Neo but still behind him
what_changes.after: Closing the gap, gaining on him
what_changes.evidence: BULLETS SPARKING and RICOCHETING around him as Agents Brown and Jones close the gap.

event_hint.one_line: Neo climbs a fire escape under gunfire as Agents Brown and Jones close in.
